chapter.verse: Nangmah na hih leh thuhilhna siangtho tawh a kituak thute na hilh in.
A teek pasalte in a pumpi deihna khaam nading, a khuaval zulhtat loh nading, a lungkip nading, upna lamah a kip nading, itna a neih nading, a thuak zawh nading na hilh in.

Tua mah bangin numei teekte in zong Pasian’ thu tawh kilawm gamtatna a bawl nading, midangte a gendai loh theih nading, kham lua-a leenggahzu’ sila ahih loh nading, thu hoih a hilh theih nading tham loin, Pasian’ thu in gensiatna a thuak loh nadingin a khangno numeite in a pasal a it ding, a tate a it ding,
a khuaval zulhtat loh ding, mi siangtho hi ding, a inn sung khempeuh a keem ding, migi ding, a pasal’ ukna a mang ding, thu a hilh theih nadingun na hilh in.
Tua mah bangin tangvalte in zong khuaval zulhtat loh nading na hilh in.
Na khempeuh ah gamtatna pha lim, nangmah mah in na pumpi-in na lak in. Thu na hilh ciangin kheemna thu om loin, khuaval zulhtat loin, mawhsakna om lo thu siangtho na hilh in.
Tua bang na hih leh, lang khatah a om mi in eite hong gensiat nading thu ngah loin a maizum ding hi.

Silate in eite Honpa Pasian’ thuhilhna khempeuh ah a zep theih nadingun amau tote’ ukna mangin, nial loin, na khempeuh a deihhuai mi hih nading leh gu sim loin na khempeuh ah dikna a kilatsak nadingun, hansuahin zol in.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, thupha lametna, a lian Pasian leh eite Honpa Topa Zeisu Khazih, minthan’na tawh hong kilat ding eite in lamenin, Pasian thu tawh kituak lo gamtatna leh deihgawhnate
nialin; tu lai hunin khuaval zulhtat lohna, thuman gamtatna, Pasian biakna lamah nopsakna bawl nadingin, Pasian’ hehpihna thupha hong kilang a, mi khempeuh kiangah gupna thu hong paipih zo hi.

Tua Topa in mawhna khempeuh sungpan eite hong tankhia dingin ahi zongin, gamtatna ahoihte ah lungsim utna nei-in, ama hong neihtuam dingin, ama ading siangthosak dingin ahi zongin eite ading ama pumpi a pia hi.
Hih thute hilhin, hansuahin zol in, thuneihna aana khempeuh tawh amaute na taai in. Kuamah kisimmawhsak kei in.
